summary: Refactored the Unity extension to expose its UI as a peer inspector tab via `inspectorTabs` instead of owning the workspace via `createView`, rewrote related tests, removed now-unused CSS, and updated `docs/extensions.md` to reflect the new client contract.
decisions: Unity's domain plugin now contributes a peer `inspectorTabs` entry (id `unity`, label `Unity`, danger badge for errors) rather than providing `createView`, so it no longer owns workspace identity.
The Unity package's `gizmo-extension.ts` wires `inspectorTabs` from the domain plugin instead of `createView`.
`UnityPanel.svelte` was introduced as a thin wrapper around `EditorPanel.svelte` so the inspector tab renders the existing editor surface.
Workspace-inspector tests now use a shared `TestExtensionPanel.svelte` fixture and a descriptor helper, and were rewritten to cover `inspectorTabs` rendering and runtime disposal/isolation.
The Titlebar test no longer imports `WorkspaceView` or mocks a `view` prop, reflecting the workspace-owner removal.
`docs/extensions.md` updated to describe the `GizmoWebExtension` client contract as including `inspectorTabs`/`commands`/`statusBar` instead of `createView`/`hasProjectStatus`.
Obsolete CSS for `unity-panel`/`unity-view-switch`/`unity-subpanel` and the `inspector-panel[data-panel='unity']` rule were deleted.
errors: Prettier check initially failed on `context-target.ts`, `PanelResizeHandle.svelte`, `app-settings.ts`, `domain-plugin.test.ts`, and `UnityPanel.svelte`; resolved by running `--write`.

Full `pnpm test` in the unity registry failed: `domain-plugin.test.ts` expected `tab.props.view.projectPath` to be `/projects/game` but received `undefined` because the mock `projects` array was empty; fixed by setting `projects: [{ title: "game", path: "/projects/game" }]`.
